programme.title: Inheriting Devotion: Living on the Pamir Plateau
programme.desc: The towering Pamir Plateau is the homeland of the Tajik people. Every household stands as a guardian of the border, and Longjike Kader's family is no exception. programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Huangshan Mountain in eastern China’s Anhui Province should be on every tea-lover’s bucket list, and hosts Tianran and Hannah are here to tell us why. This time they’re immersing themselves in Huizhou culture, a region with plenty of its own specialties, like character-shaped candy, hairy tofu, and even stinky mandarin fish. But don’t let the name fool you—this one’s a real treat.
